name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled sites, including virtual hosts, redirects, TLS, security headers, rate limiting, fail2ban, firewall and host hardening, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, listener configuration, runtime directories, logging, and required configuration workarounds.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI application from GitHub, including its virtual environment, dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
